decision: Baseline stall confirmed in the recorded bounded processes; no runtime repair or universal nontermination claim.

source_review.scope: Selected formatting implementations, leading-bit search helpers and Problem variants were read; this is not a claim to have reviewed the complete files.
source_review.path: Real alternate formatting calls decimal; unresolved scale selection falls through to Computable LowerExp. LowerExp/UpperExp call iter_msd, which searches down to Precision::MIN / 3. Fixed Display instead limits leading-bit search by absolute requested output precision.
source_review.existing_typed_frontier: Problem::UnknownZero already distinguishes an unproved nonzero value from a definite zero; Problem::Exhausted names resource rejection.

observations.completed_write_results: All 78 return Ok(()). No typed formatting failure is observed.
observations.presentation_difference: The negative unresolved 1e-40 offset prints 0.000000 under fixed formatting for both fresh and -128-prepared states; the mathematical sign-preserving reference is -0.000000. This is not a wrong exact numeric result. The present two preparation states do not establish a cache-history difference.

contract_constraints: Preserve scientific significant-digit intent, exponent, requested precision and case; fixed decimal output cannot substitute for an unresolved scientific request.
A proved zero may format as zero. Failure to prove nonzero is a distinct outcome, never a zero certificate.

Evaluate a checked formatting boundary with explicit finite refinement limits and existing typed Problems before changing infallible formatting traits. A precision cutoff by itself is not a universal wall-time, allocation or total-work guarantee.

Preserve fixed-decimal behavior separately; inspect deeper preparation, rounding carries, exact and unresolved zeros, extreme positive/negative scales and cold/warm histories before changing its signed-zero contract.
Retain the original unresolved-hypot expression, all 18 cutoff outcomes and all raw outputs. No replacement with a reduced proxy or selective sample extension is needed to establish this baseline.
next_step: Specify and prototype an isolated checked scientific-formatting boundary, with caller-controlled refinement and typed unknown-zero/resource outcomes. Include deeper preparation and rounding/carry cases; validate existing formatting and downstream report bytes before any retention.
limitations: One bounded process per row is an inventory, not a timing comparison or proof of nontermination. Only precision six and one preparation precision are covered. External wall/address-space termination is not a typed library result. Output matching is a presentation check, not an exact-zero certificate. No abort flag, budget-sweep, all-representation coverage, runtime change or full-property completion is claimed.
